role: Analog, Kelvin and compensation routing reviewer
scoreScope: Whole-board routing judged from analog/power-control perspective, not an analog-only subscore
confidence: medium-high for static geometry, medium for overall routing quality
strengths: VC is reduced 15.1854 → 12.6884 mm with unchanged parts/vias; actual inner 1 GND shields all projected top HG/SW overlaps.
Filtered-negative controller leg is 6.230 → 5.761 mm; both explicit planar 5.9 mm and conservative native 9.4 mm bounds pass including two barrel heights.
LOW trunk is 22.3418 → 20.4087 mm, compatible with VC; actual scoped copper checks pass.
eFuse output bypass is 23.0258 → 3.1735 mm on top with dedicated ground return; DVDT is 11.0130 → 5.5685 mm with 0.98 mm local ground leg.

Fresh checks of 188 selected native copper primitives against foreign pads/traces/vias/pours find zero violations; changed DVDT drill-to-pad distances are 0.45 mm and output-ground drill-to-pad 0.471 mm.

remainingLimitations.evidence: Controller raw Kelvin P/N remain 34.3334/36.7334 mm with two layer transfers each. Central pairing is preserved, but the ends remain separated; static geometry does not quantify induced error.
Positive leg remains 3.8846 mm top-only, negative 5.7614 mm uses two vias and bottom. The improvement reduces length but does not create symmetric layer environments.
VC still spans 12.6884 mm to remote R27. R27-to-C33 remains 5.0877 mm; unchanged capacitor return remains comparatively remote. Shortening is real but placement is not optimal.

Main sensitive FB path remains 9.7265 mm with two transfer vias. Fan divider/compensation legs remain 6.4042/6.3742 mm. Main output pickup 33.2701 mm is on the low-impedance side and is not equated to the sensitive FB node.
No dedicated close eFuse IN bypass was added; actual VBUS_RAW capacitor-center distances recorded in verification. Local OUT and DVDT improvements do not solve this remaining input-layout limitation.

Actual GND shielding under VC prevents direct unshielded projected top SW/HG crossings, but does not establish EMI or control-loop stability. Bottom Kelvin routing still lacks an adjacent dedicated inner 2 GND plane.

rationale: A meaningful improvement over Source 23: shorter sensitive control routes and much better eFuse output/DVDT locality with verified copper. Persistent long Kelvin, feedback and compensation geometry, asymmetric filtered-sense routing and incomplete input bypass locality keep the whole-board routing rating near 7/10 rather than 8–9. No deduction is made merely because hardware is unbuilt.
